name: ModelVariant787_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant787_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the camera orbits the active slot while the ambient light dims, a gouraud band grows in front of the slot in three stages over a fading screen flash, then a glow and a fan of spokes appear there and fade out until the light recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, sets the band tips and colours and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 on the first drawn frame, 2 once the glow has faded in the last phase and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; only the USA and Japanese discs build this header. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
